item.title: Nvidia serves 2.4T-parameter Qwen3.8 model on GB300 NVL72
item.summary: Nvidia has published Day-0 inference results for Alibaba’s open-weight Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, showing the 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8 model running across its GB300 NVL72 rack-scale system. The model has 2.4 trillion parameters in total but activates 95 billion for each token, using a fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture to reduce the amount of computation required during inference.
